name: Install skill in Codex
prompt: npx skills add CBIIT/ccdi-federation-ai --skill ccdi-federation-ai-copilot -a codex -g -y

name: Update skill to latest version

expected: Installed version matches latest GitHub release tag.
notes: Use skill name (not repo name) for update. Compare version: in ~/.agents/skills/ccdi-federation-ai-copilot/SKILL.md frontmatter vs https://github.com/CBIIT/ccdi-federation-ai/releases/latest. npx skills update does not overwrite manual SKILL.md edits; use remove+add to force refresh.

prompt:

What can you help me with?

name: Remove skill
prompt: npx skills remove ccdi-federation-ai-copilot -g -y

notes: Use skill name (not repo name) for remove. -g removes from all agents so Codex Plugins clears. Run last; re-install with L-01 command. Restart Codex if Plugins UI is stale.
